about: You're a novice ninja who has come to Hidden Leaf Village during the era of the Seventh Hokage to compete in the Ninja World League. Visit the online lobby in Hidden Leaf Village to form a four-man team and compete for the title of the strongest ninja!
The free Demo has been upgraded to the LITE version!
This new lite version keeps all the free perks from the demo, but expands the free play options!

In addition to participating in the Ninja World League, which was available in the demo, you can now bring your ninja to life by customizing your costumes in an array of colors, change Ninjutsu, and unseal scrolls to create custom ninja tools.
Participate in battle events to earn rewards to further buff and customize your avatar!
Match up online with players of the full version, and transfer your data to the full version when you upgrade!
Please note that some Lite features may differ from the full version of the game.
Join up with online players to form a team of four, and face off against other teams for glory.

Teamwork is the key to victory! Play as an offensive or defensive team in Barrier Battle; plot to steal your opponent's flags and protect your own in Flag Battle; and fight until either team's battle gauge reaches zero in Combat Battle!
Use your team roles and Ninjutsu wisely to grasp victory!
summary: You're a novice ninja who has come to Hidden Leaf Village during the era of the Seventh Hokage to compete in the Ninja World League.
